Bonus Feat.description: At certain levels, a hospitaler gains a bonus feat chosen from the list of feats available as fighter bonus feats.

Lay on Hands.description: A hospitaler who has a Charisma score of at least 12 can mend injuries through physical contact. She can restore a total number of hit points per day equal to her hospitaler level multiplied by her Charisma modifier. This healing can be split across multiple targets and need not be expended all at once. Activating this ability requires a standard action. If the hospitaler possesses lay on hands from a different class, the levels from both classes are combined when calculating the total hit points she can restore daily.

Remove Disease.description: Starting at 3rd level, a hospitaler gains the ability to use remove disease once per week as a spell-like ability. From 7th level onward, she may use this ability twice per week.

Spells per Day/Spells Known.description: A hospitaler continues to develop her divine spellcasting alongside her hospitaler training. Whenever she gains a new hospitaler level (with the exception of 1st, 5th, and 9th levels), she receives additional divine spells per day (and spells known, if relevant) as though she had advanced one level in a divine spellcasting class she belonged to prior to entering this prestige class. She does not, however, receive any other class benefits that would normally accompany such a level gain (such as enhanced undead turning or rebuking, increased smite evil damage, or similar abilities). If the character possessed more than one divine spellcasting class before becoming a hospitaler, she must select which class gains the benefit of each new hospitaler level for determining spells per day and spells known.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: Hospitalers are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, all armor types, and shields.
